subject.title: feat(ui): name Control UI sessions created with /new

question: Should Control UI permanently interpret every non-empty `/new <text>` argument as the label of the newly created dashboard session?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically sound and preserves existing validation and reset behavior, but selecting a surface-specific public command meaning requires maintainer product intent.

options.title: Approve the focused shortcut
options.body: Accept the documented Control UI-only `/new <name>` behavior and merge after current-head proof is attached.

options.title: Require explicit naming syntax
options.body: Use an unambiguous form such as `/new --name <title>` so argument meaning remains portable across surfaces.

options.title: Consolidate shared command behavior
